faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Senior Executive Assistant – Projects & Accounts recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the TISS Senior Executive Assistant – Projects & Accounts position is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Executive Assistant – Projects & Accounts post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Executive Assistant – Projects & Accounts post at TISS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor Degree with 10 years of experience or a Master Degree with 5 years of experience in Administration, Projects, and Accounts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Executive Assistant – Projects & Accounts position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Executive Assistant – Projects & Accounts role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC category candidates is Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for Women candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Personal Interaction, and a Skill Test.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode can candidates apply for this TISS recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this TISS recruitment in online mode only.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the TISS located?
faq.answer: The TISS is located in Hyderabad, Telangana.
